title: VOYAGER: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
abstract: VOYAGER is an open-ended embodied agent that uses large language models to continuously explore and learn new skills in Minecraft. It consists of three key components: an automatic curriculum, a skill library, and an iterative prompting mechanism. VOYAGER outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods by obtaining 3.3× more unique items and unlocking key tech tree milestones up to 15.3× faster.

sections.title: The Core Insight
sections.content:
Imagine you're playing Minecraft, and you want to build a house. You need to gather materials, craft tools, and construct the house. This process requires a sequence of actions, and each action builds upon the previous one. VOYAGER uses a similar approach, but instead of a human player, it's an AI agent that learns to play Minecraft by itself.

The key idea behind VOYAGER is to use a large language model to generate a sequence of actions that the agent can execute in the game world. This allows the agent to learn and adapt to new situations, just like a human player would.

sections.title: How It Works
sections.content:
VOYAGER consists of three key components: an automatic curriculum, a skill library, and an iterative prompting mechanism. The automatic curriculum generates a sequence of tasks for the agent to complete, while the skill library stores the agent's learned skills and allows it to retrieve them when needed. The iterative prompting mechanism uses the large language model to generate code that the agent can execute in the game world.

The agent learns by executing the generated code, receiving feedback from the environment, and refining its skills through the iterative prompting mechanism.

sections.title: Benchmark Results
sections.content:
VOYAGER outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods in several benchmarks. It obtains 3.3× more unique items, unlocks key tech tree milestones up to 15.3× faster, and traverses 2.3× longer distances.

The results demonstrate the effectiveness of VOYAGER's approach to open-ended embodied learning.

sections.title: Why This Matters
sections.content:
VOYAGER's approach to open-ended embodied learning has significant implications for the field of artificial intelligence. It demonstrates the potential for AI agents to learn and adapt in complex, dynamic environments, and it provides a foundation for the development of more advanced AI systems.

The ability of VOYAGER to learn and adapt in Minecraft also has practical applications, such as the development of more realistic and engaging game environments.

sections.title: Key Innovations
sections.content:
VOYAGER's key innovations include its use of a large language model to generate code that the agent can execute in the game world, its automatic curriculum that generates a sequence of tasks for the agent to complete, and its skill library that stores the agent's learned skills and allows it to retrieve them when needed.

These innovations enable VOYAGER to learn and adapt in complex, dynamic environments, and they provide a foundation for the development of more advanced AI systems.

sections.title: Try It Yourself
sections.content:
You can try VOYAGER yourself by implementing the algorithm and running it in a Minecraft environment. This will allow you to see firsthand how VOYAGER learns and adapts in a complex, dynamic environment.

You can also experiment with different parameters and settings to see how they affect VOYAGER's performance.
